units: pixels (x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: static (frame-to-frame differences are zero outside the falling glass apart from faint render noise near the alarm clock x1217-1264 y916-955 and telephone/chair x1339-1557)
camera.view: frontal, slightly elevated view of a desk against a plain teal wall; desk top recedes (back edge y~945, front edge y~1045-1060); the falling object moves in a vertical plane facing the camera, just in front of the desk-top back half

moving_objects.name: magnifying_glass
moving_objects.description: the only moving object: magnifying glass (pale silver/blue metal ring with clear lens, white ferrule, tan wooden handle with dark end cap pointing right). Starts in the air above the desk centre, falls straight down (no noticeable horizontal drift), lands on the desk top in front of the eyeglasses/paper card, rebounds/tips once and comes to rest.
moving_objects.reference_point: ref_x, ref_y = bounding-box centre of the whole object (ring + handle). lens_centre_x/y = rough centre of the lens ring where it can be read (frames 0-10 and 18-29). Blender origin is not visible; for a vertical-drop question the x choice does not matter and vertical motion of bbox centre and lens centre is the same while the object does not rotate (frames 0-10).

pixel_size.overall_length_handle_tip_to_ring_edge_p: 162 +-2 (frames 0-3, 6-10 where the glass is close to horizontal; bbox_w 161-164). Frames 4-5 read 152-153 because the glass is slightly yawed/tilted; at rest on the desk 154 (bbox 974-1127; perspective, lying on desk slightly rotated).
pixel_size.lens_ring_diameter_px: ~104 (rest frame 24, horizontal extent of ring x974-1078); ring seen as ellipse ~38 px tall at rest
pixel_size.thickness_edge_on_px: 19-22 (frames 6-8, glass seen exactly edge-on: ring rim height + handle)

moving_objects.apparent_size_change: none beyond rotation (2D scene, constant depth)

events.note: already moving slowly at frame 0->1 (bbox centre drops 8 px), essentially released at rest at ~frame 0
bbox centre y: 200.5, 208.5, 228, 261, 308, 367.5, 440, 524.5, 621, 732.5, 857.5; ring left edge constant at x 979-980 (no horizontal motion)
frame 10 bottom y=877 still in air, frame 11 resting on desk top (bottom y~1018). Contact between frames 10 and 11; frame 11 is the first contact frame

events.note: handle highest at frame 15 (t=0.625), cap top y~931
